---
description: "Create the required policy pages (Terms, Privacy, Return/Refund) for this academic vehicle service booking project"
name: "Create Policy Pages"
argument-hint: "Framework/router, target paths, and preferred tone"
agent: "agent"
---
Create or update exactly these 3 pages for this project:

1. Terms & Conditions
This system is developed for academic purposes as part of a university project. It demonstrates an online booking and payment system for caretaker services.

2. Privacy Policy
We respect user privacy. Any information entered in this system is used only for demonstration purposes and will not be shared with third parties.

3. Return / Refund Policy
Write a clear academic-demo policy consistent with this system (non-commercial context), including:
- No real-money guarantee beyond demo behavior
- Refund handling statement for simulated/educational transactions
- Contact/escalation note suitable for a university project

Requirements:
- Keep language simple, user-facing, and legally neutral (not claiming legal enforceability).
- Preserve existing project style and routing patterns.
- If routes/components already exist, update them instead of duplicating.
- If they do not exist, create the minimum required components/pages and routes.
- Return:
  - Files changed
  - Route paths added/updated
  - Final text content for each of the 3 pages

Inputs (optional):
- Frontend stack details (for example: React + React Router)
- Desired route paths
- Preferred tone (formal/simple)
- Whether to include a "Last updated" date
